raw_segments.text: The next morning poor, jaded, famished Passapart out said to himself that he must get something
to eat at all hazards, and the sooner he did so the better.
He might, indeed, sell his watch, but he would have starved first.
Now or never he must use the strong, if not melodious voice which nature had bestowed
He knew several French and English songs, and resolved to try them upon the Japanese,
who must be lovers of music, since they were forever pounding on their cymbals, tam-tams
and tambourines, and could not but appreciate European talent.
